title: Chunky Infinity Scarf
description: A cosy loop scarf worked with chunky yarn and simple double crochet. One evening project.
expectationText: The quickest scarf you will ever make. The chunky yarn builds fabric fast, and the infinity loop means no fiddly ends to worry about.

steps.title: Start the loop
steps.instruction: Chain 100 loosely. Join with a slip stitch to form a big loop, being careful not to twist the chain.

steps.title: Round 1
steps.instruction: Double crochet into each chain around. Join with a slip stitch. Chain 2.

steps.title: Rounds 2 to 10
steps.instruction: Double crochet around, joining each round with a slip stitch and chaining 2 to start the next round.

steps.title: Optional second colour
steps.instruction: After round 5 you can switch to a second colour for a two-tone look. Just fasten off and join the new colour.

steps.title: Finish
steps.instruction: After round 10, fasten off and weave in the ends. Wrap it around your neck twice for extra warmth.
